decisions.reason: The streamlined layout strategy does not change the required Agua Arc identity, colors, or logo.
Using more consistent page layouts does not cancel or modify the requirement to incorporate the organization chart.
The source decision changes the general visual treatment but does not alter table inclusion or the previously supplied table replacements.
A streamlined visual approach does not alter which marked photos must be included.
The candidate already has a message 91 MODIFY capturing the page-limit goal and reduced spacing; the source layout decision requires no additional candidate update.
The one-page letter target is independently established in message 91 and is not changed by the accepted general layout strategy.
Consistent page layouts and fewer custom treatments do not change the existing typeface or font-size rules.
The visual simplification does not remove or modify the requirement to include the supplied narrative content.
The accepted layout treatment does not authorize reordering and leaves the fixed section sequence unchanged.
The source decision does not alter the number, appendix location, or direct insertion of the supplied biographies.
A streamlined and consistent layout does not remove or modify the requirement to include a table of contents.
The revised visual approach does not change the requirement that the final PDF be print-ready.
